privacy: Live reminder schedule. Keep PII and secrets out of public files.

sleepWindow.note: Do not schedule 'when awake' recovery reminders inside this window.

reminders.name: Breakfast / light food
reminders.message: Offer breakfast or light food, encourage hydration, and try to give food with pain medication when appropriate.

reminders.name: Lunch / hydration
reminders.message: Offer lunch, encourage hydration, and keep fiber moving upward to help prevent constipation.

reminders.name: Dinner / hydration
reminders.message: Offer dinner, fluids, and a quick comfort check. Small frequent meals still count if appetite is low.

reminders.name: Evening recovery log
reminders.message: Finish the daily log, estimate running step total for the week, note bowel activity, and capture questions for PT or the surgeon.

reminders.name: Bedtime settle
reminders.message: Settle in for rest around 10 PM with elevation, clean hands, and a final comfort check. Keep pets away from the incision and bandage.

reminders.name: Tylenol next dose
reminders.title: Tylenol next dose
reminders.message: Tylenol 500 mg: next scheduled 2-tablet dose is due now based on the 6:00 PM dose and every-8-hours instructions.

reminders.name: Tramadol next dose
reminders.title: Tramadol next dose
reminders.message: Tramadol 50 mg: next dose window is now based on the 10:20 PM dose and every-4-hours PRN instructions. Give only if needed and allowed by the bottle.

reminders.name: Oxycodone next dose
reminders.title: Oxycodone next dose
reminders.message: Oxycodone was just logged. Next dose window is 6 hours later at 2:58 AM if pain still requires it and the bottle instructions allow it.

reminders.name: Ondansetron next available window
reminders.title: Nausea med available if needed
reminders.message: Ondansetron 4 mg ODT: next available window is around now based on the 10:00 PM dose and every-8-hours PRN instructions. Use only if nauseated and allowed by the bottle.

reminders.name: Tylenol morning dose
reminders.title: Tylenol morning dose
reminders.message: Take Tylenol 500 mg: 2 tablets. This is the first scheduled daytime dose from the discharge instructions.

reminders.name: Meloxicam morning dose
reminders.title: Meloxicam morning dose
reminders.message: Take Meloxicam 15 mg: 1 tablet daily starting tomorrow morning.

reminders.name: Stomach protection dose
reminders.title: Stomach protection
reminders.message: Take the stomach-protection medicine (Prilosec / Pepcid / Nexium) once daily for 30 days.

reminders.name: Aspirin morning dose
reminders.title: Aspirin morning dose
reminders.message: Take Aspirin 81 mg: 1 tablet twice daily for clot prevention, starting tomorrow.

reminders.name: Cephalexin morning dose
reminders.title: Cephalexin morning dose
reminders.message: Take Cephalexin as prescribed: 1 tablet 3 times daily for 7 days, starting tomorrow.

reminders.name: Journavx loading dose
reminders.title: Journavx loading dose logged
reminders.message: Journavx is logged in the meds dashboard at 8:35 AM EDT. Use the dashboard timer for the next dose.

reminders.name: Tylenol next dose
reminders.title: Tylenol next dose
reminders.message: Tylenol 500 mg: 2-tablet dose is due now based on the 8:08 AM dose and every-8-hours discharge instructions.

reminders.name: Cephalexin midday dose
reminders.title: Cephalexin midday dose
reminders.message: Take the second Cephalexin dose for the day.

reminders.name: Journavx 12-hour dose
reminders.title: Journavx next dose
reminders.message: Journavx next dose window based on the logged 8:35 AM dose. Check the bottle/discharge instructions and log it on the meds page if taken.

reminders.name: Senokot morning dose
reminders.title: Senokot morning dose
reminders.message: Senokot: take per bottle/discharge instructions while pain medicine is being used. Nurse review said stool softener twice daily while taking pain medicine.

reminders.name: Tylenol evening dose
reminders.title: Tylenol evening dose
reminders.message: Take Tylenol 500 mg: 2 tablets for the evening scheduled dose.

reminders.name: Aspirin evening dose
reminders.title: Aspirin evening dose
reminders.message: Take the evening Aspirin 81 mg dose.

reminders.name: Cephalexin evening dose
reminders.title: Cephalexin evening dose
reminders.message: Take the third Cephalexin dose for the day.

reminders.name: Senokot evening dose
reminders.title: Senokot evening dose
reminders.message: Senokot: take the evening dose per bottle/discharge instructions while pain medicine is being used.

reminders.name: Lyrica bedtime dose
reminders.title: Lyrica bedtime dose
reminders.message: Take Lyrica 50 mg: 1 tablet at bedtime for 30 days.

reminders.name: Tranexamic acid bedtime dose
reminders.title: Tranexamic acid bedtime dose
reminders.message: Tranexamic Acid 650 mg: bottle says take 3 tablets by mouth at bedtime. Swallow whole; do not chew or crush. Log it on the meds page if taken.

reminders.name: Tranexamic acid bedtime dose
reminders.title: Tranexamic acid bedtime dose
reminders.message: Tranexamic Acid 650 mg: bottle says take 3 tablets by mouth at bedtime. Swallow whole; do not chew or crush. Log it on the meds page if taken.
